style.prompt: Create one intuitive fantasy skill icon on a transparent background. Use a 64x64 logical pixel grid with crisp stepped edges and large solid color blocks. Center one dominant subject filling about 75 percent of the canvas, with at most one simple action or effect. Keep the silhouette readable at 32x32. No text, letters, numbers, frame, border, scenery, texture, thin lines, metallic reflections, shine, glow, gradients, particles, or dense detail. Deliberately simple and restrained.

skill.name: 窑工回火
skill.description: 命中判定成功后，先从燃烧目标提取热量，将自身护卫提升至至少4点并追加5点基础伤害，再完成劈砍并扑灭目标燃烧。
